# OneOrMore(X).newWithTerminator(T) (1, None), OccMN[X,T] = new Repeat(X, M, N).newWithTerminator(T) (M, Some(N)).

# terminator contributes nothing, a projection is collected. Covers empty-width bodies (MO, proj0, Opt[..]), min/max
# (Occ00, Occ01, Occ12, Occ22, Rep1T) and rollback (a terminator that fails partway, Chain[c,z], or ends below min).
